title: OAuth apps
intro: OAuth apps let external services (e.g. chat clients via MCP) access the wiki on behalf of a user. MCP clients like claude.ai normally register themselves automatically (dynamic client registration) — here you can additionally create and manage apps manually.
name: Name
typeHint: Public for browser/desktop clients without secure storage (the default for MCP). Confidential for server applications — the secret is shown only once.
redirectUrisHint: One URI per line. HTTPS required (http only for localhost).
secretHint: Copy the secret now. It is stored only as a hash and cannot be shown again.
rotateSecretLabel: Generate a new client secret (the old one becomes invalid)
empty: No OAuth apps yet. MCP clients like claude.ai can also register automatically without a manual app.
deleteConfirm: Really delete this OAuth app? All issued tokens will be revoked and connected services immediately lose access.
